Figure type: Diagram showing a sequence of transformations.

Description: The figure illustrates a sequence of transformations from a noisy image \(X_T\) to a clear image \(X_0\). It shows a series of transformations \(X_T, X_{T-1},..., X_0\) with arrows indicating the flow of information. The transformations are guided by two functions: \(p_0(X_{t-1}|X_t)\) and \(q(X_t|X_{t-1})\). The final image \(X_0\) is a clear representation of the original noisy image \(X_T\).

caption: Figure 5: Unconditional CIFAR10 test set rate-distortion vs. time. Distortion is measured in root mean squared error on a [0 , 255] scale. See Table 4 for details.
description:
Description: The figure shows three plots related to the rate-distortion performance of a denoising diffusion model on the CIFAR10 dataset. The left plot depicts distortion versus the number of reverse process steps, with distortion decreasing as the number of steps increases. The middle plot shows the rate in bits per dimension versus the number of reverse process steps, with the rate remaining relatively constant. The right plot illustrates distortion versus rate, with distortion decreasing sharply as the rate increases.

Text in figure: Distortion (RMSE), Rate (bits/dim), Reverse process steps (T - t), Rate (bits/dim)

Section 1: Figure showing progressive generation of CIFAR10 images using an unconditional model. It displays a sequence of images from left to right, illustrating the model's ability to generate images over time. The figure also includes sample quality metrics in the appendix.

Section 2: Figure demonstrating the effect of conditioning on the same latent variable in CelebA-HQ 256x256 samples. It shows that conditioned samples share high-level attributes, with the bottom-right quadrants representing the target variable and other quadrants showing samples from the distribution.

## Description
This figure contains two plots showing the performance of a reverse process over a series of steps. The left plot displays the Inception Score, which increases as the number of steps increases. The right plot shows the FID score, which decreases as the number of steps increases. The Inception Score peaks at around 10, while the FID score drops to near 0.

## Text in figure
Inception Score, FID, Reverse process steps (T - t)
